derivation: Derived GEOMETRICALLY from the real TY2025 f1040s1.pdf (IRS fillable form): for every entry, the widget /Rect of the field (read with pypdf) was matched against the printed line labels extracted with `pdftotext -bbox` on the blank form; a field is assigned to the line whose printed label sits on the same row (widget y-center within ~6pt of the label row) and, for table columns, whose x-band matches the printed column. Checkbox on-states were read from each widget's /AP /N appearance keys with pypdf. Printed page-1 line 10 is the total ('Combine lines 1 through 7 and 9. Enter here and on Form 1040, line 8'); printed line 9 is the 8a-8z 'Total other income' subtotal and stays blank in v1 (no 8a-8z items are modeled). Page 2: line 15 'Deductible part of self-employment tax' = f2_05 (widget row y-center 654 matches the printed label row); line 26 'Add lines 10 through 21e and line 25' = f2_30.

entries.note: Name header field (page 1); filled from the stored identity when present.
SSN header field (page 1); digits-only; report value masked.
Line 3 'Business income or (loss). Attach Schedule C' amount field, widget row y-center 576 matches the printed '3' label row.
Printed line 10 total additional income (flows to Form 1040 line 8), widget row y-center 120 matches the printed '10' label row at the bottom of page 1.
Line 15 'Deductible part of self-employment tax. Attach Schedule SE' (page 2), widget row matches the printed '15' label row.
Line 26 total adjustments (flows to Form 1040 line 10) (page 2), widget row matches the printed '26' label row.
